# The @integer samples of the cardinal plural rules of CLDR 47
# (cldr-core 47.0.0, supplemental/plurals.json). A "~" is an inclusive range.
# The "..." that ends a CLDR list is left out. Format: language category samples.
af one 1
af other 0, 2~16, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000
ar zero 0
ar one 1
ar two 2
ar few 3~10, 103~110, 1003
ar many 11~26, 111, 1011
ar other 100~102, 200~202, 300~302, 400~402, 500~502, 600, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000
he one 1
he two 2
he other 0, 3~17, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000
ru one 1, 21, 31, 41, 51, 61, 71, 81, 101, 1001
ru few 2~4, 22~24, 32~34, 42~44, 52~54, 62, 102, 1002
ru many 0, 5~19, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000
uk one 1, 21, 31, 41, 51, 61, 71, 81, 101, 1001
uk few 2~4, 22~24, 32~34, 42~44, 52~54, 62, 102, 1002
